title: GrantThai core field registry record (one line of registry/fields.jsonl)
description: Draft. One authoring field. Re-keyed from the handoff package core/05 (founder-owned, K13) per the re-key table in registry/README.md. label_en is a descriptive label from core/05, NOT an official NRIIS label; label_th stays NEEDS_VERIFICATION until captured from a public call or TOR document (K14). guidance replaces core/05's ai_prompt. Every record declares one origin (core/02 §2): NRIIS_NATIVE fields are rendered onto an NRIIS tab; every other origin is never presented as an NRIIS field (core/02 rule R4) and appears only in the output's 'Project records not placed on any NRIIS tab' appendix.

field_id.description: <NS>.<GROUP>[.<SUB>].<NAME>. Never reused; renames go through registry/aliases.yaml.

source_field_id.description: The field id in core/05 this record was re-keyed from.

section.description: core/05 section name; mapped to an NRIIS tab by mappings/nriis/section_to_tab.yaml.

origin.description: core/02 §2 origin types. NRIIS_NATIVE: a field or structure of the NRIIS proposal workflow (observed on the form or described by a public document; still NEEDS_VERIFICATION). FUND_PROFILE: a requirement of one funding call, agency, fiscal year or scheme. AUTHORING_CORE: an internal research-design field used to produce stronger NRIIS content. DERIVED: calculated from other fields. RECOMMENDED_EXTENSION: useful structure not confirmed as an NRIIS field. Only NRIIS_NATIVE records get an NRIIS.* record (tools/registry/build_nriis_fields.py).

origin_basis.description: Where the origin comes from (core/02 section, public-document page) and any GrantThai DECISION or recorded contradiction (docs/contradictions.md).

chain_node.description: The spec/common/chain.yaml node this field belongs to (a GrantThai DECISION), or null for project-level fields. In project.yaml a field with a chain_node lives under chain.<node>; a field with null lives under fields.

label_th.description: Literal NEEDS_VERIFICATION until a public-document label is captured.

type.description: Semantics of each value: spec/registry/types.yaml. For array<object>, object and rich_text|object the value contract is spec/registry/structured_fields.schema.json#/$defs/<field_id> (every such field must have one; tools/ci/check_schema_lint.py).

dependencies.description: Field ids this field depends on, or '<field_id>=<value>' conditions.

source_status.description: core/05's observation status, copied as written; PUBLIC_DOCUMENT for a field added from a public source document (docs/sources.md SD-1..SD-4), which then carries source_document. Neither makes the field official: every record keeps NEEDS_VERIFICATION.

doc_id.description: A public source document listed in docs/sources.md.

status.description: A public document describes a form edition; it does not confirm today's NRIIS form (K14).

derived_from.description: Lineage: a handoff-package core file, or a public source document (docs/sources.md), with its sha256.

render_from.description: For a narrative (rendered) NRIIS field: the fields its text is written from (core/02 §6). GrantThai never composes the text; the list tells the person what the box must summarise.

conflicts.description: Open contradictions touching this field (registry/contradictions.yaml, docs/contradictions.md). The output prints them.
